**Finding: Deviation (WARRANTY)**

- **Services limb is fine.** § 5.1(a) gives an open-ended warranty of reasonable care and skill with qualified personnel, plus a compliance-with-laws covenant (p0063) — at or above the playbook position.
- **Deliverables limb fails.** There is no conformance warranty for Materials and no malicious-code warranty, while § 5.4(c) affirmatively supplies all Materials "AS IS" with all warranties disclaimed — the playbook's walk-away position.
- **No remedy anywhere.** Nothing in §§ 5, 9 or 12.2 provides re-performance, repair/replacement or refund, so the fallback is not met on a material term.

Redline (validated, ok:true): new § 5.1(c) adding a 90-day Materials conformance and no-malicious-code warranty with an IBM-elected re-performance/repair/refund remedy, and an "EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY WARRANTED IN SECTION 5.1" carve-out in § 5.4(c) so the disclaimer does not swallow the express warranty. § 5.2 exclusivity can stand as drafted.
